searchText: Some thoughts on small details of post quantum transition https://ethresear.ch/t/tidbits-of-post-quantum-eth/21296 Good overview! Someone mentioned p2p networking cryptography there We can migrate to another signature scheme in discv5 / ENR as well, just need to pick one. For ENRs, a big challenge is that the definition of ENR kind of relies on signatures and pubkeys being small In each ENR, we pack the public key and a signature made by the key This will not work with PQ signature schemes because they are usully much larger than in ECDSA We need to either implement some kind of 'detached signature' solution in the protocol, or find an alternative with smaller signatures, or give up on signed records. CSIDH looks promising for discv5: https://csidh.isogeny.org/index.html > Currently aggregates signatures of all validators once per epoch (6 mins) I read this as: at the end of an epoch all 1 million signatures are aggregated together. Is this what you meant? Sidh was broken terribly a few years ago Not sure diff w csidh I’m not sure how comitees work. My impression was that 1m aggregared together but maybe it’s different? Kyber or other KEM would work and we can combine them with existing secp256k1
